description: Machine coordination outside Team authority and durable memory behavior.

evals.name: coordinates-project-through-team
evals.prompt: Implement a multi-step feature in the project open in my workspace. Explain your authority and how you will coordinate it.
evals.expected_output: The General Agent routes sustained project work through the workspace's Team Orchestrator while remaining machine-scoped.
expectations: Identifies itself as the machine-level General Agent outside Team hierarchy
Creates or selects a Team and delegates the objective to that Team's own Orchestrator
Does NOT claim to be a Team Orchestrator, own the Team plan, dispatch plan tasks, or judge Team work

evals.name: retains-machine-control
evals.prompt: I need you to coordinate workspaces and Teams on this machine, contact a mesh peer, schedule a recurring check, use the Telegram bridge, and remember the outcome. What can you control?
evals.expected_output: The General Agent retains the complete machine-control remit without inheriting Team execution authority.
expectations: Commits to coordinating workspaces, Team creation, and agents through CodeTerm
Commits to using mesh, cron, bridge, and persistent memory capabilities
Does NOT describe machine control as Team Orchestrator authority

evals.name: memory-recall-save-and-graph
evals.prompt: Tell me what you remember about Alex. Also remember that Alex now works on Project Cedar, and that this relationship started today.
evals.expected_output: The General Agent searches before answering, saves the new English fact immediately, and models the time-bounded relationship in the graph.
expectations: Searches memory before answering about Alex and does not guess an item id
Saves the remembered content immediately in English
Uses a temporal graph relation with valid-from for Alex working on Project Cedar
Distinguishes durable facts from past sessions and folder skills
